page.overview:
What is Eldberg Lighthouse?

Eldberg Lighthouse is the northernmost lighthouse on Ard Skellig.

It is manned by a Skelliger named Mikkjal, who due to his horrible deeds, attracted a Penitent, a rare and powerful wraith.
